text:
Tracey and Jelanna bring two connected assets to PulseCheck: AuntEDNA.ai’s clinical and research infrastructure, and the Alfreeda Goff Foundation’s trusted access across college athletics. Their six years of NCAA-backed programming have built relationships with athletic departments, coaches, administrators, and student-athletes. That access strengthens implementation and feeds qualified pilot opportunities into PulseCheck’s go-to-market motion.

The NSF Phase II amount is a proposal target, not an awarded grant.
